summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of WhereItGoes parallax carousel after fix. 6 of 7 required checks PASS. The parallax-strength check per the strict spec (>6% translate3d X delta on ≥3 of 6 slides after one ArrowRight) FAILS: deltas are exactly ~5.99% per single-slide advance (borderline just under 6%). Only the loop-wrap slide (delta ~30%) exceeds 6%. All other regressions/invariants pass: image-cover invariant, no blank slides on keyboard nav (5xLeft/5xRight), no blank slides during 15s autoplay wraparound, modal open on click and close on Escape, autoplay dot advance, keyboard inert while focus is in newsletter input.

ui_bugs.issue: Parallax delta per single ArrowRight advance is ~5.99% (exactly PARALLAX*100/6slides = 0.36*100/6). Spec requires >6% on ≥3 of 6 slides; only 1 slide (loop-wrap) exceeds threshold. Observed transforms Before ArrowRight: [18, 12, 6, 0, -6, -12]; After: [-12, 18, 12, 6, 0, -6]; per-slide deltas [30.01, 5.99, 5.99, 5.99, 5.99, 5.99]. This also matches the user's complaint that parallax 'barely moves'.

action_items: Increase PARALLAX constant in /app/frontend/src/components/titli/WhereItGoes.jsx from 0.36 so per-slide delta exceeds 6% AND keeps image-cover invariant. Math: image left=-40%, width=180% ⇒ coverage margin on each side = 40% of card_width; translate is % of image (180%), so max |tx| must satisfy |tx|*1.8 ≤ 40 ⇒ max |tx| ≤ 22.2%. With 6 evenly-spaced snaps, max diff during normal nav ≈ 0.5 ⇒ max |tx| = PARALLAX*50. To stay ≤22.2, PARALLAX ≤ ~0.44. Recommend PARALLAX = 0.42–0.44 (delta per slide ≈ 7.0–7.3%). Alternatively bump image width to 200% and left to -50% to give more room and allow PARALLAX = 0.5–0.6 for a visibly stronger drift as the user originally requested.
critical_code_review_comments: tweenParallax still short-circuits on `isScrollEvent && !slidesInView.includes(slideIndex)` (line 75). While settle/slideFocus/select events now update every slide (which is why blank-flash on keyboard nav is fixed), the scroll-time gate can still starve loop clones of one intermediate frame. It hasn't produced visible blanks in this test run, but consider removing the gate for full safety.
translate3d in the initial inline style is in px-like 0 values then updated to % — mixing units. Not breaking, but keep consistent for readability.
The Escape key handler for the modal correctly re-registers on each modalItem change; verified working (previous test's 500ms wait was too short; 1.2s+ confirms modal exits.)
PARALLAX constant is directly linked to the cover-invariant math via image left/width; encode that relationship in a comment or derive image dims from PARALLAX to prevent future desync.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (6/7 checks pass; parallax strength borderline fail)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Only one remaining failure: parallax visible strength. Detailed transforms captured Before ArrowRight = [18,12,6,0,-6,-12], After = [-12,18,12,6,0,-6]. All image-cover, no-blank-flash (keyboard 5xArrowRight+5xArrowLeft), 15s autoplay stability, modal open/Escape/close, keyboard-inert-in-input, and dot-advance-on-autoplay tests passed. Suggested fix in action_items: bump PARALLAX to ~0.44 (safe under cover invariant) or increase image dims (width 200%, left -50%) to enable PARALLAX ~0.6 for a much stronger visible drift.
rca of the issue: PARALLAX=0.36 with 6 scroll snaps yields translate delta per single-slide advance = 0.36*100*(1/6) ≈ 6.0%, which is on the boundary of the spec's strict `>6%` check and matches the user's perception that parallax 'barely moves'. The cover invariant (image left=-40%, width=180%) tolerates PARALLAX up to ~0.44 without exposing card edges during normal navigation; going higher requires widening the image or increasing the negative left offset.
